|errata_history=This card has one published text. The Virtual Block slip and the Players Committee card image shown here print it.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 5, slip 28 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>; the slip ([[:File:VB7-p5-109-Ten_Numb.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-tennumb-pre.gif]]) print it; the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 15)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=15, page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text. The PC website card list<ref name="cl-1273_28">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref> shows the same card with the card list's usual notation (icons written out or dropped, quotes as single quotes); that is not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026); it also writes “Rogue Squadron Pilot”, “B-Wing”, “X-Wing” (capitals) — a capitals/punctuation-only difference, held for the wiki owner's ruling and not made a version.
